Your expertise in the Belgian insurance market, on a long-term assignment with a software vendor serving the country’s leading insurers.

Business Analyst Insurance | Freelance | Brussels

Our client is an international software vendor whose insurance division develops a modular solution covering the entire insurance value chain: distribution, policy management, claims and accounting.

What makes it stand out? A human-sized Belgian team on the insurance side, backed by an international organisation and by product and development teams of several thousand people.

The Belgian market is a strategic priority for the group, which already counts major clients there. Contracts are signed for long periods, often around ten years, giving freelancers real continuity of assignment.

With a growing project portfolio, the company is looking for several freelance Business Analysts specialised in insurance.

All of this within a hybrid and flexible organisation, anchored in Brussels.

The job

• Assigned to a client project, you hold a central role between the insurer, its business teams and the vendor’s engineering teams.
• Understand the client’s needs, challenge them and match them against the capabilities of the solution.
• Analyse the gap between the client’s processes and the standard product, then identify the required configurations or customisations.
• Work on one or more modules depending on your specialisation: group life, individual life, non-life, and potentially claims or finance.
• Be operational from day one and bring your knowledge of the Belgian market straight into the project.
 
Role
• Gather, analyse and challenge the business needs of insurance clients.
• Carry out the gap analysis between the client’s processes and the standard functionalities of the solution.
• Identify and formalise the configurations and customisations to be implemented.
• Translate business needs into clear functional requirements that engineering teams can work with.
• Ensure the day-to-day link between the client’s business stakeholders and the product and development teams.
• Work within your area of specialisation: group life, individual life or non-life insurance.
• Support the configuration and implementation of the solution throughout the project.
• Take part in functional validation and testing of delivered developments.
• Relay Belgian market developments and client expectations to the product teams.
• For the most specialised profiles, contribute to modules deployed across several clients.
Profile
• Freelancer with experience directly tied to the Belgian insurance market: banking experience alone is not sufficient for this role.
• Around 5 to 10 years of business experience, with the ability to be operational immediately, without a training period.
• Proven expertise in one specialisation: group life insurance (including employee benefits), individual life or non-life.
• Experience with an insurer, with a consultancy active in the sector, or with a software vendor specialised in insurance.
• Good knowledge of developments in the Belgian market, particularly local legislation and insurers’ expectations.
• Ability to translate these business stakes into concrete requirements for engineering teams.
• Excellent interpersonal skills and ease with a wide range of stakeholders, from business teams to management.
• Full autonomy and the ability to take ownership of your scope from the start.
• English is essential for working with the international teams, complemented by French or Dutch depending on the client.

Your role as Team Manager Value Management
 
 

• You define the Value Management strategy and roadmap for Business Solutions, focused on retention, renewals and gross margin protection. 

• You identify the main drivers of churn, revenue erosion and value leakage, and translate data and customer insights into high-impact actions. 

• You connect customer outcomes with financial impact and balance customer needs with sustainable value creation. 

• You drive a cross-functional value agenda across Product & Journey, Commercial, Delivery & Services and Operations, securing ownership and commitment. 

• You build and lead a multidisciplinary team, set priorities and develop its analytical, commercial and influencing capabilities. 

• You establish governance, KPIs and decision forums that make customer value and gross margin visible in business decisions. 

• You determine priorities and trade-offs, monitor progress and intervene when delivery or impact stalls.  

Your profile as Team Manager Value Management
 
 

• You hold a master’s degree or have equivalent experience. 

• You have at least 5 years of relevant experience in Value Management, Customer Lifecycle Management, Retention, CX, Commercial Strategy or Business Transformation within a complex B2B environment, including 2 years in a leadership role. 

• You understand the commercial and financial drivers behind retention, renewals and gross margin and translate them into clear business choices. 

• You build coalitions, negotiate priorities and create ownership beyond your own team, including without direct authority. 

• You combine strategic and analytical thinking with the ability to set direction in situations of ambiguity and incomplete information. 

• You are decisive and outcome-oriented, and comfortably balance customer needs, commercial ambitions and organizational realities. 

• You are a compelling communicator and mature people leader who influences senior stakeholders and develops multidisciplinary teams. You are fluent in English; Dutch is a strong asset.

The employer is a dynamic and growing organisation operating within a modern commercial and operational environment. Bringing together various services, activities and partners on one site, the company relies on strong internal coordination to ensure smooth day-to-day functioning. To support this mission, it is looking for an Office Manager who will play a key role in the operational and administrative management of the location.

Jobomschrijving

The Office Manager acts as a central point of coordination for the Technical Director and supports various operational teams across the shopping centre.Administrative Management She/he manages internal and external communications, prepares and reviews documents, maintains updated tenant information, circulates weekly footfall data to the Landlord, the Property Manager and the internal team, and organises meetings and conferences. She/he also manages agendas, appointments and administrative workflows.Coordination She/he collaborates closely with internal departments, external partners and tenants to ensure fluid communication and the smooth running of ongoing projects. Responsibilities include drafting meeting minutes, monitoring deadlines, managing office supplies, and overseeing the Info Desk schedule, orders and administrative tasks, including basic support with SUMUP-related matters.Reception & Customer Relations As a representative of the shopping centre, she/he welcomes visitors, partners and clients in a warm and professional manner and provides clear, accurate information regarding the centre's services and activities.Information Management She/he maintains all records, files and databases, ensures confidentiality and data security, oversees the publication and updates of House Rules on Chainels and manages internal communication such as "What's Up" on Chainels.Support to Management She/he assists the Facility Manager with follow-up on files such as security and insurance, prepares ad hoc reports and summaries to support decision-making and provides occasional support to the marketing team when needed.

The ideal candidate demonstrates professionalism, discretion and strong organisational abilities.Key criteria include:

• A flexible and hands-on approach.
• A degree in Business Administration, Secretarial Studies or a related field.
• Previous experience in an Executive Assistant, Office Manager or similar role; experience in a shopping-centre environment is a strong asset.
• Excellent organisational, prioritisation and time-management skills.
• Strong proficiency in MS Office and digital tools.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work autonomously, anticipate needs and take initiative.
• High level of discretion and a proactive mindset.
• Fluency in French, Dutch and English.

Our client is a well-established global technology and manufacturing organization with over a century of industry expertise. The company develops innovative commercial equipment and intelligent embedded control systems used by businesses and institutions worldwide.

Jobomschrijving

• Design, develop, and maintain embedded firmware using C programming for electronic control systems.
• Develop reliable and efficient software solutions for next-generation embedded products.
• Create and execute test plans and validation activities to ensure product quality and performance.
• Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to validate firmware on prototypes and production units.
• Perform root cause analysis, troubleshooting, and debugging of firmware and hardware integration issues.
• Optimize communication and interaction between embedded systems, peripherals, and control components.
• Work extensively with embedded interfaces and peripherals, including UART, I2C, ADC, PWM, EEPROM, timers, and interrupts.
• Support new product development initiatives, feature enhancements, and product releases.
• Manage firmware revisions, documentation, and engineering change activities.
• Utilize source control and issue-management tools to support structured development practices.
• Provide technical support to manufacturing teams during pilot builds and production deployments.
To apply online please click the 'Apply' button below. For a confidential discussion about this role please contact Gift Petto on  66 2 012 5067.

• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
• Minimum 7 years of experience in embedded firmware development.
• Strong proficiency in C programming for embedded systems.
• Hands-on experience working with microcontrollers and embedded communication protocols.
• Solid understanding of UART, I2C, ADC, PWM, EEPROM, interrupt handling, and timer-based applications.
• Proven experience in debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization of embedded applications.
• Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.
• Experience working with issue-tracking and software development lifecycle tools.
• Knowledge of test-driven development or structured software testing methodologies is an advantage.
• Ability to work effectively with international engineering teams and stakeholders.
• Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving capability, and attention to detail.
• Good communication skills with the ability to work in English-speaking environments.

For a banking customer in Brussels, we are searching for a freelance SQL DBA for a senior mission.
Responsibilities

• Help define, implement and maintain highly available, performant & scalable database systems to effectively meet IT Business requirements

• Be involved in deployment and patching automation

• Maintain (backups, transaction log management, index optimisation etc) and upgrade the database systems etc

• Review database schema changes to ensure compliance with standards and ensure optimal choice of indexing, column definitions etc.

• Help with problem solving in case of performance problems or functional issues in applications

• Build a strong relationship both within the infrastructure team and with the development teams

• Promote best practices

• Maintain the deployment pipeline

Additional details

Seniority: Medior/Senior

Start Date: October/November

Duration: Long-term

Extension: Yes

Contract: Freelance

Location: Brussels

Onsite Policy: 50%

Hours Per Week: 40

Languages: Fluent English and French/Dutch

• Strong experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, Oracle and enterprise database operations

• Hands-on experience with AWS database services (Aurora, RDS for SQL Server, PostgreSQL and MySQL, DynamoDB)

• Experience with GIT, Jira and CI/CD-driven deployment processes

• Experience with cloud security, encryption, backup and disaster recovery solutions

• Experience with performance monitoring and capacity management in cloud environments

• Knowledge of Power BI, SSAS or reporting platforms

 

Nice to have:

• VMware vSphere and ESXi administration knowledge

• CommVault or enterprise backup solutions

• Basic networking and load-balancing (F5) concepts

• Azure Entra ID and Azure platform services

• Basic knowledge of Go or Python programming language

Soft skills

• Good communication skills enabling you to explain complex technical issues is an easy-to-understand way

• Like to keep up to date with the latest technology trends

• Fluent English and good knowledge of either French or Dutch

• Advanced investigation & problem solving skills with strong analytical skills

• Availability & flexibility

• Interested in cloud technologies and what the future may bring

• Have a clean certificate of good behaviour
